blockers: No natural temporal/geographic subgroup-mixture shift validation or invariance audit.
Abstention/fallback operator cost is not measured.
No reviewer-safe raw prediction/loss package, split/config manifest, or environment lock for independent full empirical replay.

E03 remains snapshot-reported only: no application contract records the split identity, collection/sampling mechanism, candidate/FIT isolation, paired sufficient statistics, or UCB implementation/configuration needed to establish the conditional-i.i.d. CP/Hoeffding/MPB contract.
M3 allocation records are aggregate-only; no seed-level uncertainty analysis is possible from the frozen artifact.
M3/M3.5 have no observable external stratified frame or collection trace, so their true-class count rules remain oracle-stratified diagnostics rather than label-acquisition policies.
fMoW executable release/version/license/checksum and split hashes must be recorded before the planned real-shift run.
Final author submission checklist remains (including deadline/action confirmation and any official portal-required fields).
evidence_ceiling_reassessment_requires: An E03 application contract with immutable split identity, sampling/collection provenance, candidate/FIT isolation, paired sufficient statistics or reviewer-safe raw replay inputs, executed UCB configuration, and environment; run a clean reviewer-safe replay when required to establish the contract.
A natural time/geographic subgroup-mixture shift evaluation with a predeclared within-group invariance audit if the paper retains practical deployment relevance.
A precommitted fallback/abstention cost or utility outcome, or measured sensitivity analysis, if operational abstention claims are retained.
checkpoint_selection: Revision 04 is the best verified artifact because the corrected proof scope and build are independently verified. It is not an accept-ready checkpoint, does not imply score improvement, and does not supersede the Round-2 evidence ceiling of 4.
